Land of the Free summary

Welcome to the home of the Langford family. Nolimit City takes a satirical look at a quirky American trailer park in the Land of the Free slot. The game initially presents a five by four grid setup where the fifth reel remains locked, offering 256 base ways to win. However, unlocking that final reel expands the potential to 1024 ways. If you want to experience this bizarre slice of Americana without opening your wallet, you can play for free directly on Playin.com right now.

Base Game Mechanics and Features

The base game relies heavily on the active Conveyor Belt located beneath the bottom row, which brings in various special modifiers. You can find the Protein Powder Keg to create fully stacked symbols, or Bottles that convert random paying symbols into Wilds. Keep an eye out for the half stacked Benzo Bear, which adds Wilds and Scatters to the grid, and Mr Split on the fifth reel, who utilizes the xSplit mechanic to divide symbols and increase your win ways. A Chainsaw might also appear to split those positions even further. For players who want to alter the pace, engaging the xBet feature guarantees a Scatter on the first reel. There is also the submarine feature which triggers a Titan Spin, where landing a specific character awards a massive instant multiplier, acting as the game's immediate xGod mechanic.

Bonus Rounds and Free Spins

Unlocking the true potential requires landing enough Scatter symbols. A single Scatter on the first four reels will unlock the fifth reel, but you need three, four, or five Scatters to trigger twelve, fifteen, or twenty Tsunami Spins. During Tsunami Spins, the bottom two rows are submerged underwater, and landing Rubber Ducks will raise the water level while adding extra spins. Once the water covers all four rows, the feature upgrades to Submerged Spins. In this deep water mode, special symbols like the Benzo Bear and Mr Split become fully stacked and apply their effects to everything below the surface. You can test your luck with these rising tides by entering a free slot tournament to compete against others for real rewards.

Volatility Rating and Potential

Nolimit City has designed this chaotic family adventure with an Extreme volatility rating. The potential payouts are massive, peaking at an incredible maximum win of 57,000 times your base bet. Because the modifier combinations and water level mechanics can be quite complex to understand at first glance, taking advantage of our risk free platform is highly advised. Using your Playin coins allows you to figure out the intricate details of the conveyor belt and the different free spin modes without putting any of your own money on the line.

Game Features

Reel Area

The game has 5 reels with reel 5 locked in the main game. The reel setup is 4-4-4-4-4 and a Conveyor Belt beneath the bottom row. All reels are unlocked during the Tsunami Spins and Submerged Spins.

xBet®: Asscar Mode

At a cost of an extra 25%, the player is guaranteed a Scatter symbol on reel 1. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

Wild and Stacked Symbols

In main game the Wild symbols can land on any reel. Partial and fully stacked character symbols may land. Fully stacked character symbols convert into stacked Wild symbols.

Conveyor Belt

A wide range of features may appear on the Conveyor Belt on each spin, which alters the reels somehow.

Bottles

A crate with 1 or 2 bottles. 1 bottle will convert any random paying symbol on the same reel into Wild. 2 bottles — The first bottle will convert any random paying symbol on the same reel into Wild and the second bottle will split that Wild symbol into two parts.

Protein Powder Keg

PROTEIN POWDER KEG Gets activated if there is a partially stacked symbol on the same reel. It converts the partially stacked symbol to a fully stacked symbol.

Benzo Bear

BENZO BEAR A half stacked Benzo Bear only exists in main game and will convert 3- 8 random symbols into Wild and/or Scatter. A fully stacked Benzo Bear only exists in Submerged Spins and will convert all symbols below water surface into Wild.

Mr. SPLIT & Chainsaw

Mr Split can only appear on reel 5 if it’s unlocked and will split all symbols except Scatter from reels 1-5 on a row according to its size. It can appear half or fully stacked in the main game. During Tsunami Spins and Submerged Spins, Mr Split appears as a fully stacked symbol and will split all symbols that are below water surface. The chainsaw will be active if Mr Split is present on unlocked reel 5. Chainsaw will add 1 more split to the already split positions on the same reel where it appears.

Rubber Ducks

When appears during Tsunami Spins and/or Submerged Spins, it awards +2 spins per Rubber Duck. Each Rubber Duck increases the level of water by one row during Tsunami Spins.

TITAN SPIN (Idiot Spin in the Bonus Buy)

When a submarine enters during any spin in the main game or Tsunami Spins/ Submerged Spins, Titan Spin will be triggered. One of three ‘Presidants’ may land in the submarine window and the multiplier of that ‘Presidant’ will be applied to the base bet. If no ‘Presidant’ lands, it is a no win. The three ‘Presidants’ and their multipliers are: Presidant 3: 15000x Presidant 2: 25000x Presidant 1: 57000x Titan Spin is termed as Idiot Spin for bonus buy.

Scatters

In main game the Scatter symbols can land on any reel. Landing one Scatter anywhere on reel 1-4 unlocks reel 5. Landing 3/4/5 Scatter will trigger Tsunami Spins and will award 12/15/20 spins respectively.

Tsunami Spins

All reels are active. It starts with bottom 2 rows submerged under water. When all 4 rows are covered by water, Tsunami Spins are upgraded to Submerged Spins.

Submerged Spins

All 4 rows are covered by water level.

Pearly Gates

The max payout of the game is 57,000 times the base bet. When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 57,000 times the base bet is awarded.

Nolimit Bonus Buy

Buy your way straight into the different bonus features, ranging from 68 to 2,310 times the base bet. • Tsunami Spins can be bought for 68 times bet, the maximum possible bet is €100.00. • Submerged Spins can be bought for 258 times the bet, maximum possible bet is €100.00. • Lucky Draw can be bought for 115.5 times the bet, maximum possible bet is €100.00. • Idiot Spin can be bought for 2,310 times the bet, the maximum possible bet is €100.00.

The Nolimit Bonus feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

ACTION SPINS

Get your adrenaline flowing and play your regular bonus rounds in HYPER MODE! ‘Action Spins’ is a new optional feature that ushers in an innovative way to play a high volume of rounds of the Base Game or Multiple Bonus rounds in a rapid and exhilarating way!

The Action Spins feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Game xMechanics

xBet®

At an extra cost per spin, the player gets an increased chance of getting into the Bonus Modes. The way this happens varies from game to game. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

xGOD®

The most potent feature to date in the Nolimit City xMechanic portfolio. xGod® was first introduced in the game Nine to Five, released in November 2023. xGod® is a powerful single feature capable of delivering the max win in an instant. May trigger the max win in the base game or the bonus modes - without the assistance of any other features in the game or wins in the game.

xSplit®

xSplit® was first made available within xWays Hoarder xSplit, released in July 2021. On this first occasion, xSplit symbols go a long way towards assisting wins through the feature, as any xSplit symbols in view to the right of a Scatter symbol will turn the Scatter into a Super Scatter symbol – which within this release assists in progressing the feature through several levels. However, aside from the progression through bonus levels, xSplit as individual symbols increase win ways during base play. Any xSplit symbol in view will split all symbols to the left of it into two, increasing the ways to win. After this, the xSplit symbols will turn into wilds – for the potential of huge wins.
